proof_attempt_summary: Derived and independently reviewed the jointly uniform smooth proxy minimax order min{sqrt(T), lambda^-1[1+log_+(T lambda^2)]}, retaining assigned-arm feedback, the actual-table comparator and full-horizon depletion; strengthened it to a matched hard-proxy sqrt(T) theorem with an explicit lambda=T^-2 rule. The leading transition value remains explicitly open, and useful constants, efficient computation and actual worst-coordinate MSE are undelivered; no Lean formalization or substrate promotion occurred.
tldr: Two fixed-population causal means share one sequential treatment probability under hidden uniform enrollment and original selected-arm vector feedback. The smooth proxy applies the normalized log-sum-exp to design expectations and compares with one constant allocation optimized for the actual roster. Its proved jointly uniform learning price has order \(r(T,\lambda)=\min\{\sqrt T,\lambda^{-1}[1+\max\{0,\log(T\lambda^2)\}]\}\), with constants \(10^{-40}\) and \(50000\). Fixed positive smoothing yields logarithmic cumulative smooth-proxy loss. The derived exact hard-proxy minimax frontier has square-root order: \(10^{-40}\sqrt T\le R_T^{\max}\le50000\sqrt T\). The finite grid rule at \(\lambda_0=T^{-2}\) attains a hard bound of \(50001\sqrt T\). The normalized approximation budget is \(\lambda\log2\). These are conservative second-moment proxy guarantees for fixed vector HT estimation; practical calibration and the leading transition value remain unresolved.
gap: Scalar adaptive precision, smooth terminal stochastic optimization, and cumulative-saddle optimization leave different load-bearing information and comparator boundaries.
